findings.explanation: PO-1005 is referenced by both the invoice and the receipt but no purchase order document exists in the evidence set, so the authorized terms and approval for this 59,000 INR spend cannot be verified.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the invoice date of 2026-07-21, an out-of-sequence ordering that may simply reflect goods received before invoicing but warrants confirmation.
